newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK CBANK SAYS ONE-DAY REPO RATE UP TO 17.5 PCT.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK CBANK SAYS ONE-DAY REPO RATE UP TO 17.5 PCT.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) on Monday said the average and only rate at its one-day securities repurchase tender rose to 17.5 percent, up from 12.0 percent in the last similar tender on March 6.
On Friday, the NBS's three-day average repo rate rose to a record high of 21.2 percent.
The NBS added that it had allocated funds totalling 2.0 billion crowns, the full fixed amount it had offered in Monday's the tender.
The NBS said bids totalled 2.827 billion crowns.
According to official NBS figures, the banking sector is short of liquidity ahead of the minimum reserve period, with banks' minimum reserve demands fulfilled at 90.71 percent as of Sunday.
